attributes.action:
The UK is on its knees!!!!
We need a general election now!!!
attributes.additional_details: The mainstream media are only showing what pays their taxes. This isn’t fair. I and the majority do not want Andy burnham as the leader of the government of the uk.
attributes.background:
Call a general election. 
Having Andy burnham foisted upon our country is not fair. He was elected to get rid of two tier kier. We should now be allowed a choice on our prime minister!
